# Code of Conduct

We want Sothema HR Intelligence to be a respectful, inclusive, and professional project for everyone contributing to the RH application.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and constructive.
- Focus feedback on the code, design, data flow, and documented requirements.
- Protect candidate privacy and never share personal data in issues, pull requests, or screenshots.
- Welcome different perspectives and ask questions in good faith.
- Report security or privacy issues privately rather than exposing them publicly.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, unauthorized disclosure of personal information, credential sharing, and disruptive behavior are not acceptable.

## Enforcement

Report concerns privately to the repository maintainers. Reports will be handled confidentially and reviewed fairly.
